project.title: Acinetobacter baumannii Ci79 WT and TrxA mutant outer membrane vesicle proteins
project.projectDescription: To investigate whether OMVs can be modulated by TrxA, we isolated OMVs from wild type (WT) and TrxA-deficient (ΔtrxA) A. baumannii clinical isolate Ci79, and carried out a functional and proteomic comparison.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: The OMV-associated proteins were subjected to trypsin digestion for capillary LC/MS/MS analysis.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: WT and trxA OMV proteins were identified by mapping the mass spectrum to the translated protein sequences from the Ci79 genome. Analysis of the raw mass spectrometric data was performed using MaxQuant software package (version 1.6.3.3).
